plainText:
Kenyu Horiuchi (Japanese: 堀内賢雄 Horiuchi Ken'yū) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Horiuchi was born on July 30, 1957, in , . He first worked on during , where he played the recurring role of Cedric Juniper. During , starting in SM093, he gained his biggest roles, , Samson Oak, and the narrator; he replaced the late Unshō Ishizuka in the process.
